::: notes
Predict before revealing each result. Increasing compounding frequency increases the final amount when the same nominal annual rate is used. Annual \$9724.05; semi-annual \$9747.22; monthly \$9767.16; daily \$9771.09 under the 365-period assumption. The increases become smaller, not proportional to the number of periods. Controls allow frequency changes with principal, rate and years held fixed. Follow-up: “Why is the result different although the quoted annual rate is unchanged?”
:::
